display.name: Day AI
display.summary: Reads Day AI CRM records, meeting transcripts, pages, and campaign details.
examples: What changed in the Acme opportunity?
Summarize our latest meeting with Acme.

connection.note: Day AI MCP requires the paid Agent tier. Sign in, then choose the workspace and agent whose read-only data you want Rytangle to access.

agent.name: day-ai
agent.description: Read-only access to Day AI CRM records, meetings, pages, and campaigns available to the signed-in workspace and agent tier. A paid Day AI Agent tier is required.
agent.owns: You own Day AI workspace CRM records, meetings, pages, and campaigns visible to the signed-in user. Use read_crm_schema before searching unfamiliar objects. Read-only tools only; do not create, update, or send anything. Include record links or transcript citations when available.

tool_descriptions.search_objects: Search contacts, companies, opportunities, meetings, emails, pages, and other CRM objects.
tool_descriptions.read_crm_schema: Read object properties, valid values, and relationship schemas.
tool_descriptions.read_object_history: Read the change history of a CRM record.
tool_descriptions.read_property_history: Read the change history of a property across records.
tool_descriptions.get_meeting_recording_context: Read meeting metadata, summaries, notes, and transcript.
tool_descriptions.get_context_for_meeting_recording_citati: Find transcript excerpts with exact citations for a question.
tool_descriptions.read_meeting_comments: Read comment threads attached to a meeting recording.
tool_descriptions.read_page: Read a page by object ID in paginated chunks.
tool_descriptions.read_page_comments: Read comment threads on a page.
tool_descriptions.get_campaign_details: Read a campaign's details and status.
tool_descriptions.read_folder: List the subfolders and pages inside a folder.
